source_text: Malefici usque ad scinifes aliquid imitantur; ultra non possunt. Daemonum virtus finita; Dei signa crescunt. Ecclesia discernat imitationes haereticas a veritate.
pass_a_gloss: Magicians up-to gnats something imitate; beyond not they-can. Of-demons power finite; of-God signs increase. Church let-it-discern imitations heretical from truth.
pass_b_english: The magicians can mimic as far as the [[gnats >> Bible:Exodus 8:18-19]]; beyond that they fail and confess [[“This is the finger of God” >> Bible:Exodus 8:19]]. Demonic power is finite; God’s signs increase. So the church must distinguish flashy imitation from the truth that alone liberates.
